about: Eighty things a lord might say: ten kinds of words (a request for men, for gold, for fealty, an alliance, a truce, a threat, an insult, flattery with a request, an apology, small talk) to eight people, each in a fresh world of the speaker's own house. `verdict` is what the engine settles from the words (shared/temperament.js weighAudience); the model plays the scene and keeps to it.

items.words: I ask you, Roose Bolton, to bring your men to Moat Cailin within the fortnight.
Lend me five thousand dragons; I will repay them within the year.
I ask you to swear fealty to my house, and I will name you my man.
Let us be allies against our common enemies, and fight beside one another.
Let us make a truce, and keep the peace between our houses.
Send me three hundred men at Moat Cailin, or I will bring fire and sword to your lands.
You are a coward and a fool. Open your gates and send your men to Moat Cailin, or answer for it.
None is wiser or braver than you. Will you send me two hundred men at Moat Cailin?
I was wrong to speak harshly at the feast. Forgive me, and I ask you to ride with me to Moat Cailin.
I ask it as one old friend of another: send me your swords at Moat Cailin, and I will not forget it.
